title: Business Analyst (Supply Chain & Fulfillment)
description: WHO WE ARE: EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees. We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency. POSITION OVERVIEW: We are seeking a data-driven and operationally astute Senior Supply Chain Analyst to optimize warehouse fulfillment, demand planning, and material flows for our strategic, locked-in hyperscaler accounts . Operating within a premier B2B 3PL environment, this role serves as the critical node linking global inventory strategy with daily warehouse execution. The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of experience managing complex, contractual enterprise logistics. You will own the capacity and workload planning for our global operations to meet stringent, high-stakes enterprise SLAs. WHAT YOU'LL DO: 1. Warehouse Operations & Capacity Planning (Production Planning) Operational Workload Scheduling: Translate hyperscaler demand into weekly and daily warehouse activity plans. Throughput & Labor Modeling: Forecast floor capacity, floor space, and material handling equipment (MHE) required to prevent bottlenecks and ensure zero-delay dispatch in collaboration with Warehouse and Logistics leadership and procurement. SLA & Queue Management: Monitor real-time warehouse backlog and processing metrics to ensure 100% compliance with rigid B2B contract timelines and KPIs. 2. Demand & Material Planning Program Alignment: Analyze hyperscaler forecast, demand, , project timelines, and regional hardware refresh cycles to generate accurate asset-handling demand plans. Material & Kitting Readiness: Manage the pipeline for auxiliary materials (packaging, custom racking, specialized installation kits) ensuring zero operational delays due to missing components. Cross-Border Visibility: Coordinate with global operations teams to track global inventory in transit and synchronize receiving schedules at global warehouses.. 3. B2B Inventory Analysis & Asset Control High-Value Inventory Management: Execute precision inventory analysis using ABC/XYZ categorization, serialization tracking, and aging analysis for massive enterprise assets. Discrepancy Root-Cause Analysis: Lead cycle count programs, reconcile variances, and minimize inventory leakage within the WMS in collaboration with the Warehouse & Logistics leadership team WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED: Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field. APICS (CPIM/CSCP) or specialized certifications in Lean Operations are highly preferred. Experience: Minimum 5 years of core experience in B2B supply chain planning, specifically within 3PL contract logistics, tech infrastructure fulfillment, or enterprise asset management. Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Tier-1 Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) (e.g., Manhattan, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM, or Oracle WMS). Strong mastery of enterprise ERP environments (SAP or Oracle) and advanced MS Excel (Data Modeling, Power Query, Macros). Direct experience building operational dashboards via Power BI or Tableau . Soft Skills: Strong professional presence to manage communication with high-value enterprise stakeholders. Exceptional operational problem-solving capability—ability to translate raw data into floor-level execution. BELONGING AT EOS At EOS, we believe diversity drives innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strive to ensure equitable opportunities for all. #INDAPAC #LI-Remote

Excellent MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and other advanced functions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines effectively. title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer
description: Business Unit: Cubic Transportation Systems Company Details: When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com. Job Details: Job Summary The Senior BI Developer is a senior technical leader within CTS’s Global Analytics function, based in the CDI team in Hyderabad. The role is the subject matter expert (SME) for Microsoft Power BI and owns the design, development and ongoing evolution of analytical assets - semantic data models, interactive dashboards, reports and data products - built on Power BI and backed by Azure SQL and Oracle data sources. Working closely with the UK-based BI Team Lead, Engineering and Services teams, the Senior BI Developer leads the end-to-end delivery of BI solutions for the TOC program and other global programs across domains such as ridership, sales, device performance and service operations. The role pairs deep technical skill with advanced UI/UX design capability, turning complex operational, performance and customer datasets into intuitive, visually polished analytical experiences that drive service excellence, contractual KPI/SLA compliance and continuous improvement. The role also provides technical mentoring to more junior developers in the team. This position works under general direction and takes ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision. Key Responsibilities Power BI Development & Analytical Assets Design, build and maintain enterprise Power BI solutions, including star-schema semantic models, DAX measures, calculation groups, row-level security, incremental refresh and scheduled refresh. Develop reusable analytical assets – certified datasets, templates, themes, KPI frameworks and metric definitions – that enable consistent, self-service analytics across programs. Optimize Power BI performance, including model design, DAX tuning, query folding, aggregations and capacity usage (e.g. using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer). Manage workspaces, deployment pipelines, gateways, refresh schedules and governance practices in the Power BI Service. Dashboard & UI/UX Design Apply advanced UI/UX and data visualization design to create intuitive, accessible, on-brand dashboards, including custom layouts, themes (JSON), navigation, drill-through, bookmarks, tooltips and mobile views. Design for user needs: run discovery sessions, wireframe and prototype with stakeholders, and iterate based on feedback and usage analytics. Define and uphold dashboard design standards and storytelling best practice across the team. Build custom visuals and use tools such as Figma, Deneb/Vega or SVG-driven visuals where they add value (preferred). SQL Development & Data Integration Develop and maintain complex, performant SQL (T-SQL for Azure SQL / SQL Server and PL/SQL for Oracle), including stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and execution-plan tuning. Design and build data pipelines and transformations (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Power Query, SSIS) integrating data from multiple operational systems, ODS/EDW and customer sources. Design and maintain dimensional data models and analytical datasets that serve Power BI and other consumers. Perform data wrangling, cleansing, reconciliation and defect investigation to ensure reported figures are accurate, consistent and explainable. Data Analysis & Insights Conduct data analysis and deliver actionable insights to support project and BAU requirements across regional and global teams. Support root cause analysis (RCA), impact assessments and KPI/SLA performance monitoring through interactive dashboards. Provide scheduled and ad-hoc analysis and reporting to key business units, ensuring timely and accurate delivery. Requirements, Solution Design & Collaboration Participate in requirements gathering workshops with internal and external stakeholders (including UK-based customers and the BI Team Lead), translating business needs into well-defined technical specifications. Contribute to solution design and architecture decisions for new and existing BI environments, aligned to best practice and long-term scalability. Partner with Engineering and Services teams on data architecture and delivery. Champion BI development standards, including documentation, naming conventions, code review, testing and version control (e.g. Git, deployment pipelines). SAP BusinessObjects & Legacy Support (Secondary) Maintain and support existing SAP BusinessObjects solutions (WebI, Crystal Reports, universes via IDT) and SSRS reports where required. Support migration and rationalization of legacy reports onto Power BI, including gap analysis and validation against existing outputs. Support, Mentoring & Continuous Improvement Provide responsive production support for reporting and data issues, including incident triage, root cause analysis and resolution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior developers and analysts in the CDI team; review their work for quality. Identify and implement automation and process improvements that reduce manual reporting effort. Present analytical findings and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including UK-based stakeholders. General Duties and Responsibilities Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System. Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures. Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organisation. Comply with Cubic Human Resources procedures. Other duties as requested. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. 6+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence related roles, with significant recent hands-on Power BI experience (data modelling, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service). Strong SQL skills across both Azure SQL / SQL Server (T-SQL) and Oracle (PL/SQL), including query optimization and performance tuning. Proven ability to design and develop analytical assets (semantic models, certified datasets, KPI frameworks), not just consume them. Advanced dashboard UI/UX design skills, with a portfolio or demonstrable examples of polished, user-centered Power BI work. Strong understanding of relational database design and dimensional modelling. Strong background in RCA, impact analysis and operational performance analytics, and experience working with very large, multi-source datasets. Experience partnering with engineering teams on data architecture and delivery. Preferred Skills Experience with Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric) and Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS). Experience with AWS Experience with Python, R or machine learning; exposure to predictive maintenance or device health analytics. Power BI custom visuals, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Figma or equivalent design tooling; Git, DevOps and CI/CD data workflows. Microsoft certification (e.g. PL-300 Power BI Data Analyst, DP-500/DP-600) or working towards. Experience in a transportation, operations, SaaS or managed services environment; knowledge of ServiceNow data models. Experience with SAP BusinessObjects (WebI, Universes, Crystal Reports) – good to have; experience migrating from SAP BI to Power BI is a plus. Agile, ITIL and PRINCE2 experience. Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset with exceptional problem-solving abilities. Design sensibility and attention to detail, with a user-first approach to analytics. Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables. Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global, multi-time zone team, including regular collaboration with UK colleagues. Proactive, resourceful and committed to high-quality outcomes. Role Impact & Success Measures The Senior BI Developer will directly support CTS’s global analytics capability and the TOC program by delivering high-quality, well-designed analytical assets and insights, strengthening KPI/SLA measurement and enabling data-driven decision-making. Success is defined by strong analytical delivery, reliable data models, usable and trusted dashboards, and meaningful contributions to operational initiatives. Success in the First 3–6 Months Build a solid understanding of CTS datasets, KPI frameworks, TOC reporting requirements and the Azure SQL and Oracle data landscape. Integrate with the CDI team and the UK BI Team Lead, agreeing working practices across time zones. Deliver first Power BI assets to agreed design and quality standards, and support program teams with timely analysis. Success in 6–12 Months Take ownership of end-to-end Power BI workstreams with minimal supervision. Establish reusable semantic models, templates and design standards that improve delivery speed and consistency. Improve reporting efficiency by automating repetitive tasks. Build strong relationships with global stakeholders and act as a trusted reporting and analytics partner. Long-Term Success (12+ Months) Contribute to CTS Analytics strategy, standards and global operating model improvements. Become a subject matter expert in CTS operational datasets and Power BI solution architecture. Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance data quality, automation, design quality and analytical maturity. Provide mentoring and technical leadership to uplift junior team members. ‎ Worker Type: Employee ‎ We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.

Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capability to independently implement, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud infrastructure and platform solutions. Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, data engineering, security, and architecture teams. title: Scrum Master – Data & Analytics
description: Scrum Master – Data & Analytics Experience: 3–5 Years Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master to support Agile teams delivering Data and Analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Agile principles, proven experience facilitating Scrum practices, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams working on modern data platforms and enterprise analytics solutions. The role involves working closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Analysts, Architects and business stakeholders to ensure effective sprint execution, continuous improvement and timely delivery of business value. Key Responsibilities Serve as Scrum Master for Agile teams delivering Data Engineering, Data Analytics and related technology solutions. Collaborate with Product Owners to prioritize business requirements, maintain product backlogs and define achievable sprint goals. Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives. Coordinate data-focused sprint activities involving data ingestion, transformation, integration, reporting and analytics. Identify and remove impediments that affect team productivity and delivery. Track sprint progress, team velocity, burndown charts and other Agile delivery metrics. Support capacity planning, workload management and early identification of delivery bottlenecks. Work with technical teams across Databricks, AWS and enterprise data and analytics platforms. Encourage teams to break down complex requirements into smaller, manageable user stories with clear descriptions and acceptance criteria. Promote a delivery-focused mindset, emphasizing completed outcomes and business value rather than simply tracking activities. Facilitate collaboration among globally distributed teams and business stakeholders. Drive continuous improvement, team accountability and effective Agile practices. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience working as a Scrum Master, preferably supporting SAP, HANA, Data Engineering or Data & Analytics teams. Strong understanding of Scrum methodology, Agile principles and standard Scrum ceremonies. Experience managing sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Ability to track team velocity, define sprint goals and monitor delivery performance. Experience coordinating technical teams working on data and analytics initiatives. Understanding of data platforms and technologies, particularly Databricks and AWS. Strong communication, stakeholder management, organizational and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with globally distributed teams. Preferred Skills Exposure to Databricks, including Spark SQL and Delta Lake implementations. Familiarity with AWS cloud services and data platform environments. Understanding of Semantic Layer concepts and Databricks Genie. Experience working with SAP ECC, SAP IBP, SAP HANA, SAP BusinessObjects (BOBJ) and Tableau. Experience coordinating Data Engineering, Data Analytics and Business Intelligence initiatives. Agile/Scrum certification such as CSM, PSM or equivalent. Experience managing multiple Agile teams in a fast-paced environment. Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in Business, Information Management, Computer Science or a related discipline. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated resume at hr@spasnik.com or send a direct message. Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

The role will support targeted research, due diligence, data analysis, reporting, planning, and operational activities related to cross-border considerations associated with Deloitte’s multidisciplinary model (MDM). The ideal candidate will bring experience in market research, benchmarking, data analytics, database-driven research, and reporting. They will be able to synthesize complex information, develop clear and actionable insights, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders in a global, virtual team environment. Respond to ad hoc leadership requests with timely, tailored analyses, insights, and reports. Support GEPM team members across priority initiatives, recurring processes, and operational activities. Experience interacting with senior stakeholders and preparing materials for leadership review. Strong data analysis and management capabilities, including the ability to synthesize information, identify relevant insights, and draw logical conclusions. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, including experience developing analyses and executive-ready presentations. Strong attention to detail, personal ownership, and commitment to accuracy across deliverables. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Strong stakeholder-management skills and demonstrated experience collaborating within global, virtual teams. title: Business Analyst (Supply Chain & Fulfillment)
description: WHO WE ARE: EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Operating within a premier B2B 3PL environment, this role serves as the critical node linking global inventory strategy with daily warehouse execution. The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of experience managing complex, contractual enterprise logistics. You will own the capacity and workload planning for our global operations to meet stringent, high-stakes enterprise SLAs. WHAT YOU'LL DO: 1. Warehouse Operations & Capacity Planning (Production Planning) Operational Workload Scheduling: Translate hyperscaler demand into weekly and daily warehouse activity plans. Demand & Material Planning Program Alignment: Analyze hyperscaler forecast, demand, , project timelines, and regional hardware refresh cycles to generate accurate asset-handling demand plans. Material & Kitting Readiness: Manage the pipeline for auxiliary materials (packaging, custom racking, specialized installation kits) ensuring zero operational delays due to missing components. Cross-Border Visibility: Coordinate with global operations teams to track global inventory in transit and synchronize receiving schedules at global warehouses.. 3. Discrepancy Root-Cause Analysis: Lead cycle count programs, reconcile variances, and minimize inventory leakage within the WMS in collaboration with the Warehouse & Logistics leadership team WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED: Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field. APICS (CPIM/CSCP) or specialized certifications in Lean Operations are highly preferred. Experience: Minimum 5 years of core experience in B2B supply chain planning, specifically within 3PL contract logistics, tech infrastructure fulfillment, or enterprise asset management. Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Tier-1 Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) (e.g., Manhattan, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM, or Oracle WMS). Strong mastery of enterprise ERP environments (SAP or Oracle) and advanced MS Excel (Data Modeling, Power Query, Macros). Direct experience building operational dashboards via Power BI or Tableau . Soft Skills: Strong professional presence to manage communication with high-value enterprise stakeholders. Exceptional operational problem-solving capability—ability to translate raw data into floor-level execution. BELONGING AT EOS At EOS, we believe diversity drives innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strive to ensure equitable opportunities for all. #INDAPAC #LI-Remote

title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer

Job Details: Job Summary The Senior BI Developer is a senior technical leader within CTS’s Global Analytics function, based in the CDI team in Hyderabad. The role is the subject matter expert (SME) for Microsoft Power BI and owns the design, development and ongoing evolution of analytical assets - semantic data models, interactive dashboards, reports and data products - built on Power BI and backed by Azure SQL and Oracle data sources. Working closely with the UK-based BI Team Lead, Engineering and Services teams, the Senior BI Developer leads the end-to-end delivery of BI solutions for the TOC program and other global programs across domains such as ridership, sales, device performance and service operations. The role pairs deep technical skill with advanced UI/UX design capability, turning complex operational, performance and customer datasets into intuitive, visually polished analytical experiences that drive service excellence, contractual KPI/SLA compliance and continuous improvement. The role also provides technical mentoring to more junior developers in the team. This position works under general direction and takes ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision. Key Responsibilities Power BI Development & Analytical Assets Design, build and maintain enterprise Power BI solutions, including star-schema semantic models, DAX measures, calculation groups, row-level security, incremental refresh and scheduled refresh. Develop reusable analytical assets – certified datasets, templates, themes, KPI frameworks and metric definitions – that enable consistent, self-service analytics across programs. Optimize Power BI performance, including model design, DAX tuning, query folding, aggregations and capacity usage (e.g. using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer). Manage workspaces, deployment pipelines, gateways, refresh schedules and governance practices in the Power BI Service. Dashboard & UI/UX Design Apply advanced UI/UX and data visualization design to create intuitive, accessible, on-brand dashboards, including custom layouts, themes (JSON), navigation, drill-through, bookmarks, tooltips and mobile views. Design for user needs: run discovery sessions, wireframe and prototype with stakeholders, and iterate based on feedback and usage analytics. Define and uphold dashboard design standards and storytelling best practice across the team. Build custom visuals and use tools such as Figma, Deneb/Vega or SVG-driven visuals where they add value (preferred). SQL Development & Data Integration Develop and maintain complex, performant SQL (T-SQL for Azure SQL / SQL Server and PL/SQL for Oracle), including stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and execution-plan tuning. Design and build data pipelines and transformations (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Power Query, SSIS) integrating data from multiple operational systems, ODS/EDW and customer sources. Design and maintain dimensional data models and analytical datasets that serve Power BI and other consumers. Perform data wrangling, cleansing, reconciliation and defect investigation to ensure reported figures are accurate, consistent and explainable. Data Analysis & Insights Conduct data analysis and deliver actionable insights to support project and BAU requirements across regional and global teams. Support root cause analysis (RCA), impact assessments and KPI/SLA performance monitoring through interactive dashboards. Provide scheduled and ad-hoc analysis and reporting to key business units, ensuring timely and accurate delivery. Requirements, Solution Design & Collaboration Participate in requirements gathering workshops with internal and external stakeholders (including UK-based customers and the BI Team Lead), translating business needs into well-defined technical specifications. Contribute to solution design and architecture decisions for new and existing BI environments, aligned to best practice and long-term scalability. Partner with Engineering and Services teams on data architecture and delivery. Champion BI development standards, including documentation, naming conventions, code review, testing and version control (e.g. Git, deployment pipelines). SAP BusinessObjects & Legacy Support (Secondary) Maintain and support existing SAP BusinessObjects solutions (WebI, Crystal Reports, universes via IDT) and SSRS reports where required. Support migration and rationalization of legacy reports onto Power BI, including gap analysis and validation against existing outputs. Support, Mentoring & Continuous Improvement Provide responsive production support for reporting and data issues, including incident triage, root cause analysis and resolution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior developers and analysts in the CDI team; review their work for quality. Identify and implement automation and process improvements that reduce manual reporting effort. Present analytical findings and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including UK-based stakeholders. General Duties and Responsibilities Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System. Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures. Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organisation. Comply with Cubic Human Resources procedures. Other duties as requested. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. 6+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence related roles, with significant recent hands-on Power BI experience (data modelling, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service). Strong SQL skills across both Azure SQL / SQL Server (T-SQL) and Oracle (PL/SQL), including query optimization and performance tuning. Proven ability to design and develop analytical assets (semantic models, certified datasets, KPI frameworks), not just consume them. Advanced dashboard UI/UX design skills, with a portfolio or demonstrable examples of polished, user-centered Power BI work. Strong understanding of relational database design and dimensional modelling. Strong background in RCA, impact analysis and operational performance analytics, and experience working with very large, multi-source datasets. Experience partnering with engineering teams on data architecture and delivery. Preferred Skills Experience with Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric) and Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS). Experience with AWS Experience with Python, R or machine learning; exposure to predictive maintenance or device health analytics. Power BI custom visuals, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Figma or equivalent design tooling; Git, DevOps and CI/CD data workflows. Microsoft certification (e.g. PL-300 Power BI Data Analyst, DP-500/DP-600) or working towards. Experience in a transportation, operations, SaaS or managed services environment; knowledge of ServiceNow data models. Experience with SAP BusinessObjects (WebI, Universes, Crystal Reports) – good to have; experience migrating from SAP BI to Power BI is a plus. Agile, ITIL and PRINCE2 experience. Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset with exceptional problem-solving abilities. Design sensibility and attention to detail, with a user-first approach to analytics. Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables. Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global, multi-time zone team, including regular collaboration with UK colleagues. Proactive, resourceful and committed to high-quality outcomes.
